summary:
The page renders correctly under the new component: the four simulation views now sit in a fixed two-row `FigureCompare`, all four complete and within one screen, and the program checks pass (build, component library, data fidelity, overflow).

**Change made:** in the 模拟视图 section, the four screens (原界面 + 红色盲/绿色盲/蓝色盲) were switched from `FigureGrid` to the new `FigureCompare`, the component designed for exactly this "一组四张" case — the group is now fixed at two rows with all four views at the same size, instead of a ratio-height grid. Import updated accordingly; nothing else changed.

**Page structure:** 结论 (verdict + summary) → 核心指标 (issues/pairs/fail/confuse, one row) → 模拟视图 (four CVD simulations) → 类型分布 → 对比度 → 色对混淆 → 问题明细 → 背景信息.
